name: What is the average cost range for a custom tiny home from Zen Tiny Homes?
description: Custom tiny home costs typically range from $75,000 to $150,000, depending on size, materials, and features.

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost range for a custom tiny home from Zen Tiny Homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom tiny home varies significantly based on size, chosen materials, features, and level of customization. While we don't provide fixed prices, our custom tiny homes typically range from $75,000 to $150,000. This estimate covers design, materials, labor, and standard finishes. Premium finishes, specialized appliances, or unique architectural elements can impact the final price. We provide a detailed quote after finalizing your design specifications, ensuring full transparency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom tiny home costs typically range from $75,000 to $150,000, depending on size, materials, and features.
